scope: Fixed 192 full protocol-path games (96 paired swaps), candidate category correction plus hp-type-evidence versus pre-category local a48a40e without that feature. Uniform draws over the existing 24-team catalog, with the shipped weighted 103-team belief prior, no forced opening or hidden opponent information. Equal 27000 iterations and c=0.4, not equal wall time. Common battle and agent seeds within each swapped pair. One current native referee for both workers. This is a local intervention comparison, not deployed-bot superiority, general team-distribution superiority, human calibration or optimality proof. No optional stopping or adding seeds to seek significance. Report pair-based betting95 interval from the frozen evaluator; positive evidence only if its lower bound exceeds 0.5 after all 192 games. Non-significance is inconclusive, not equivalence. Exposure to public type constraints is reported separately; this combined intervention does not isolate category correction from type inference. Timings are Mac measurements only.
